title: Manage AWS accounts
content:
New . Don't forget to update .

Order new AWS account

If you do not have a distribution list for operational contact for the AWS account create a new group in for example Office.

If you create and manage the group in Office 365 you have an easy to use GUI to work with. In the end this will be an Azure AD object if you want to manage via Azure portal instead. Make persons that should have possibility to manage members owner of group.



New AWS accounts from are ordered via https://cloud.ingka.com/solutions/new

or 

by sending a mail to cloud support, cloud.support@ikea.com.


AWS Contact setup:

IKEA IT contacts for account database:

Contact person (email) - all persons that has access to cloud portal: Solution owner email + Solution Architect email
Contact email  - the person who will get billing information email: Solution owner email

Technical contact (email) - Get technical information: Any technical contacts with access to Cloud portal e.g. IKEA Solution Architect and DevOps@inter.ikea.com.

AWS contact:

When account is received, set Alternate contacts, Operations (found below Profile/My account) created distribution list mail.

Don't forget to update .

Specify budget threshold for account in Cloud portal.
